name: Guangdong Silver Age Sci & Tech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Silver Age Sci & Tech Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of advanced polymer materials. The company boasts an extensive product portfolio that includes a wide array of thermoplastic resins such as polypropylene (PP), acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS), polycarbonate/ABS alloys, polystyrene (PS), polyamide (PA), polybutylene terephthalate (PBT), polyethylene terephthalate (PET), polyphenylene sulfide (PPS), PVC/ABS alloys, thermoplastic elastomers (TPE), and silicon-based products. Beyond these, it supplies specialized functional materials like rubber, LED light diffusion compounds, thermal management materials, packaging solutions, and flame retardant products. Guangdong Silver Age also engineers materials for enhanced performance characteristics, including fuel resistance, improved weathering capabilities, reinforced toughening, and various plastic alloys, alongside environmentally durable options. Its offerings further extend to include LED lighting kits and structural design consultation services. These versatile materials find broad application across numerous industrial sectors, notably in household appliances, automotive manufacturing, IT electronics, LED illumination, power tools, wire and cable production, and road construction. Established in 1997, the company is headquartered in Dongguan, China. It originally operated under the name Dongguan Silver Age Plastics Co., Ltd before officially rebranding to Guangdong Silver Age Sci & Tech Co.,Ltd. in December 2006.
